_readme: OpenActive publishers, for mapsee_ingest_openactive.py. Read that file's
header first - the four traps it documents are the whole reason this config
is short when the published catalogue is 175 entries long.
EVERY FEED HERE IS CC-BY 4.0, and so is every one that was rejected: all 127
dataset pages that parse across the five catalogs carry the same licence.
That is unusual enough to say out loud - a whole national catalogue on one
term. The attribution it requires is written into every row's description by
the adapter; it is a condition, not a footer.
VERIFIED 2026-08-26 by running the adapter itself against each candidate and
counting rows that are FUTURE, PLACEABLE and inside the horizon. Nothing is
configured on the strength of a feed answering 200 - wisconsinbikefed parsed
beautifully into 50 VEVENTs and every one of them was in the past.
Better (GLL)            11,287    Places Leisure          10,757
Everyone Active          7,502    Pembrokeshire Leisure    2,612
Castlepoint              1,307    GoodGym                    724
Exercise Anywhere          595    Our Parks                  584
Open Sessions               73    SportSuite                  55
Playwaze                    19    Oxford University Sport     16
~35,500 upcoming sessions, and the three largest were still PAGE-CAPPED at
40 pages, so that is a floor rather than a total.
WHY THESE CATEGORIES. `fitness` for a leisure-centre timetable, because the
classifier cannot recover a swim or an aqua-aerobics class from its name -
the same measurement that put `fitness` on a pure cycling calendar and
`community` on a mixed advocacy one. `sports` for the club platforms, whose
listings are named games. GoodGym is the exception and is `volunteer` with
running and community secondaries: its sessions are people running to do a
physical task for an older neighbour, which is genuinely both.
RE-SURVEYED 2026-10-05 FOR COMMUNITY- AND LEISURE-CENTRE DROP-INS, AND NOTHING
WAS ADDED. The collection now lists 169 dataset sites in 5 catalogs. 141 parse;
26 answer 403, 1 is refused by robots.txt and 1 is an empty page. Of the 141,
12 are configured here and 82 are bookteq venues that publish only FacilityUse
and Slot. 32 are Legend tenants, and Legend answered 403 partway through a walk
(a platform rate limit, not a standing refusal: see `_not_included`).
9 give no feed type. 6 more publishers have session feeds: Played, Find My
Facility and Willen On Ice were walked to the end and replayed through this
adapter, TeamUp and Bookwhen were sampled, and 1 is a test copy. Upshot, untyped,
was walked too. The OpenActive Offer fields that would mark a drop-in
(advanceBooking, prepayment) are filled on 0 of 53,242 offers across 47,998
records read that day, so every feed was judged from its own words. Each verdict,
with its numbers, is in `_not_included`.

sources.name: Better (GLL)
sources._max_pages: Better is the largest publisher configured and 250 pages was not the end of it: 125,000 ScheduledSession records read and the cap reported, correctly, that its NEWEST sessions were missing. 700 covers the feed with room; the walk is affordable because collapse_booking_grids takes what it returns from ~59,700 rows to ~9,200.

sources.name: GoodGym
sources._measured_2026_10_05: Live, 3 requests: 799 records, 66 refused for no coordinates. The feed stamps every time in UTC ('Z'), and the adapter reads the wall clock from the offset a feed sends, so a session either side of the 2026-10-25 clock change folds into TWO windows an hour apart: 17 of 38 standing rows on the adapter at 3835373. 'Volunteering at Bexley parkrun' became Saturday [07:30-09:00, 08:30-10:00]; it is one 08:30 London session (07:30Z to 10-24, 08:30Z from 10-31). With the London-clock change replayed in scratch, 0 of 40. Its recurring_days are rewritten by the refresh once that change lands. SECOND FAULT, LARGER: every GoodGym row says 'Free to attend.', but after the description, so the sync's 800-character cut removed it from 271 of 508 rows and ../mapsee 0227 tagged 249 free. Admission first through mapsee_admission (scratch): 0 cut, 485 of 490 tagged. 1 record is an 'Online drop-in session' for the Older People programme, which the proposed online check refuses.

sources.name: Our Parks
sources._measured_2026_10_05: Replayed through the adapter 2026-10-05: 2,144 records, 36 kept, 34 standing rows. TWO FAULTS, neither fixed by the London-clock change. (1) 31 of the 34 standing rows carry two windows an hour apart on one day, because the publisher holds each session at a FIXED UTC INSTANT across the clock change: 'Run Club' @ Victory Park (E20) is 08:00+01:00 to 2026-10-18 and 07:00+00:00 from 2026-10-25 (07:00Z throughout), so the fold writes Sunday [07:00-08:00] AND [08:00-09:00]. Which half of the year is right cannot be read from the feed. (2) 5 standing rows (60 future records) are 'Our Parks Live' online classes ('This live online session is only available through Our Parks Plus', a paid membership in the place's own description), pinned at 51.5162,-0.1735 and marked 'Free to attend.' because the offer price is 0. The feed marks them OfflineEventAttendanceMode, and mapsee_ingest.looks_online_only does not read that wording. Online-only is out. Both need adapter changes. The proposed online check (the phrase 'online session/class/workout' unless a hybrid phrase is present, or OnlineEventAttendanceMode) refuses exactly those 60 here; across every cached feed it refuses only 9 more, Played's 'Beginner ESOL Lessons (ONLINE)', and GoodGym's 1. With it, 30 Our Parks rows are stored, and 26 of their 29 standing rows still carry the doubled window.

_why: Probed 2026-08-26 and NOT configured. Recorded so nobody spends another
curation run re-discovering them - `_not_included` is an editorial no, and
anything proposing sources must consult it (mobilizon_sources.json's rule).
_not_included.https://data.englandnetball.co.uk/: DEAD, and it answers 200 while being so. Walked 40 pages: 14,798 records, latest start date 2019, ZERO in the future. Seven years stale and still listed in the official OpenActive catalog. This is the source that proves the walk-to-the-end rule matters in both directions - Our Parks looks equally dead on page one and has 854 future sessions.
_not_included.http://data.letsride.co.uk/: British Cycling's ride feed. 172 rides dated in the YEAR 2500 (a sentinel), and the rest 2010-2012. The horizon guard would refuse the 2500s correctly and there is nothing real behind them. Worth re-probing in a season - British Cycling runs a great many free rides and this feed used to carry them, so this is an `empty` rather than a `fail`.
_not_included._legend_platform_sessionseries_only: ABOUT THIRTEEN PUBLISHERS on legendonlineservices.co.uk (BwD Leisure, Serco Leisure, Lancaster, Active Nottingham, Alive Leisure, Leisure Focus, Horizon, SLL and InspireAll, Loughborough University and more) publish a SessionSeries feed and NO occurrence feed. Measured: ~30,000 records between them, many with perfect coordinates (SLL and InspireAll: 3,302 records, 0 missing a coordinate) and ZERO with a startDate, because a series describes a PATTERN in `eventSchedule` rather than an occurrence. The adapter counts them as 'no start date' rather than guessing, which is the right refusal and leaves real supply on the table. Reading them means expanding a PartialSchedule over a rolling horizon - exactly what mapsee_ingest_markets and mapsee_ingest_parkrun already do for weekly schedules - and it is the single highest-value thing to add here next. It was not done in the same pass because the MyListing lesson applies: when a source offers two spellings of one date, find a record where they DISAGREE before choosing, and doing that politely needs a feed that is not currently rate-limiting us. RE-MEASURED 2026-10-05, AND THE SHAPE ABOVE IS NO LONGER TRUE. The feed each Legend dataset site labels SessionSeries (`<tenant>-openactive.legendonlineservices.co.uk/api/sessions`) now carries dated ScheduledSession records. Each one carries its SessionSeries EMBEDDED as a `superEvent` object, with a second EventSeries level inside it for the activity. The place and its coordinates live only on that embedded series. This adapter reads `location` at the top level, so on Active Luton (3,703 records, 40 pages, read to the end) it refused all 2,599 sessions in the next 90 days as 'no coordinates'. Replayed in scratch, folding the embedded series in kept all 2,599, and the weekly fold took them to 169 standing rows at 5 venues, priced 'Non-member' GBP 4.10-8.80. Three more facts matter for that change. The series `url` is the venue's goo.gl map short link (goo.gl is shut), so it must not become the row's ticket link. The adapter at 3835373 writes no fee line, so these rows would not say they cost money. Read through mapsee_admission instead, 6,233 of the 7,220 cached Legend records that carry offers come out 'Not a free public admission offer. Eligibility restrictions apply.': its offer-name check reads 'Non-member' (5,995 offers), which is the public price, as a members' tier. Never free, but the price is lost. LEGEND ANSWERED 403 PARTWAY THROUGH THE WALK, AND IT WAS A RATE LIMIT. Active Nottingham answered 403 on page 12, after 51 Legend feed pages in a row had answered 200 (Active Luton's 40 and its own 11). The survey paced each SUBDOMAIN at 1 request a second, so its limiter never saw that all 51 pages went to one backend. The same URL answered 200 (184,043 bytes) at 17:19 UTC that afternoon, re-checked by the review, and the tenant robots.txt answers 404. Pace Legend per PLATFORM, not per host. THE WALK DID NOT STOP AT THAT 403, AND IT SHOULD HAVE: 29 more requests went to two more tenants (Alive Leisure 11, ending in its own 403 on page 11, then Angus Alive 18). The next session stops at the first 403 on any Legend subdomain. Active Nottingham's 11 pages held 559 sessions; 403 of them fall in the next 90 days, and only 9 of those carry a coordinate. Ask Legend before configuring any tenant, and do not walk 32 tenants on a schedule without that answer.
_not_included._facility_slots: 93 of the 127 parseable publishers offer ONLY FacilityUse and Slot feeds - bookable courts, pitches and halls. A bookable badminton court at 19:00 is an empty room somebody may or may not take, not an occasion, and putting one on a map of what is happening is the Traders Village mistake: the feed works and it is not what it looks like. 2026-10-05: 82 of the 141 dataset sites that parse are FacilityUse+Slot only, and all 82 are bookteq.com venues (app.bookteq.com/api/openactive/catalogue): schools, cricket and rugby clubs, councils' pitches.
_not_included._leisurecloud_dataset_pages_403: 26 dataset sites answered HTTP 403, with a styled block page, to this repo's User-Agent on 2026-10-05. 25 are Gladstone leisurecloud tenants (*.gs-signature.cloud, *.leisurecloud.net) and 1 is partners.playfootball.net: Active Hartlepool, Active Leeds, BCC Leisure, Be Well Wigan, Brimhams Active, Chelmsford City Sports, Conwy, Lampton Leisure, LED Leisure, Leisure SK, Leisure World, lleisure, OCLL, One Leisure, PlayFootball, Plymouth Council, Rivers Fitness, RSL, Southwark Council, TMA, Tower Hamlets Council, Trafford Leisure, Wellington Club, West Wight, WV Active and Your Leisure. The five tenants configured above answered 200 from the same platform in the same minute, so the block is per tenant. Their feeds would be opendata.leisurecloud.live/api/feeds/<Tenant>-live-*, but only the refused page gives the tenant name. Guessing it would be working around the refusal. Ask the operator. That is the largest leisure-centre supply left in the catalogue: Leeds, Tower Hamlets, Southwark, Trafford, Wigan and Plymouth.
_not_included.https://openactive.played.co/openactive/: Played, a booking platform. 2026-10-05: 2,950 SessionSeries (12 pages) and 32,875 ScheduledSessions (124 pages), both read to the end. 12,241 occurrences named a series the feed did not carry. 1,771 sessions fall in the next 90 days, and the adapter kept 203 rows (107 of them standing). 64% are Active Norfolk's holiday-activity places (1,100), many marked 'BNHF Funded Places Only', which means eligibility-restricted. The rest: We Move She Moves 161 (women-only classes, GBP 5-6), Deep Dish Beach 157 (camps and parties, GBP 15), Lewisham Community Space 136, golf tasters 78 and Barnet Libraries 44. Every session is booked through Played, and no offer says otherwise. Of the 1,717 sessions with a series, 107 say drop-in, pop-in or 'no need to book' in their own text, and 91 of those use no booking words: seated exercise, Bounce and Rhyme, Walk and Talk. The adapter has no per-row filter that could keep only those. Lewisham Community Space's 'Beginner ESOL Lessons (ONLINE)' would be pinned to a hall. Also, 29 of the 65 rows the adapter marked 'Free to attend.' lost that line in the sync's 800-character cut, and 2 of 134 fee rows read as free. Replayed with the mapsee_admission change in scratch: 0 cut, 0 fee rows free. NOT a drop-in timetable.
_not_included.https://openactive.upshot.org.uk/: Upshot, a charity monitoring CRM. 2026-10-05: 3,010 Event records (153 pages of 20, read to the end). 346 fall in the next 90 days, all free and all with coordinates. They come from 2 organisers. stayActive4Life has 322: Strength & Balance falls-prevention classes for over-50s in Ealing and Hillingdon halls and churches, run in term blocks ('Oct 26 - Dec 26'). Its listings found by web search (stayactive4life.org, careplace.org.uk) say you self-refer or come by GP referral and book on Bookwhen, so they are a referral course and out. Lord's Taverners' Wicketz cricket hub in Springburn, Glasgow has 24, free and weekly, and could qualify only after two adapter faults are fixed. First, the feed stamps every time in UTC ('Z'), and the adapter at 3835373 reads the wall clock from the offset sent, so the weekly fold invents a window an hour early for the dates before 2026-10-25. 'Weekly Coaching' @ Glasgow Club Springburn became Thursday [17:00, 18:00, 19:00], where the classes run at 18:00 and 19:00 London (17:00Z and 18:00Z before the change, 18:00Z and 19:00Z after). 30 of Upshot's 31 standing rows had a window shifted by the hour. With the London-clock change replayed in scratch, only Weekly Coaching keeps two windows, [18:00, 19:00], and those are two real classes. Second, the adapter cannot keep one organiser of two, and the term blocks fold into standing rows that never die. 2 of the 346 are eventStatus EventCancelled ('Off due to Xmas/NY holiday.'). The adapter at 3835373 lists them and folds them into standing rows; the proposed eventStatus check refuses both. app.upshot.org.uk's robots.txt is 'Disallow: /'. The feed is a documented API and exempt, but no organiser page can be read to check a session.
_not_included.https://www.willenonice.co.uk/openactive: Ice Leisure / Willen On Ice (admin.rinktix.com catalog, its only entry). 2026-10-05: 4 series and 311 sessions, 3 requests, 2026-11-21 to 2027-01-03. It is a seasonal pop-up rink beside a fairground, selling GBP 11.90 timed tickets ('Book now') with capacity 150. It is not a centre's timetable. The adapter's weekly fold turns its six-week season into 4 standing rows that roll forward for ever. Better as one dated seasonal event from another adapter. 2 of the 311 are eventStatus EventCancelled (Wilbur's Little Skaters and Quiet / SEND Session, 2026-12-06), and the adapter at 3835373 folds both into standing rows.
_not_included.https://goteamup.com/api/openactive/v1/: TeamUp, a gym and studio booking platform. 2026-10-05, sampling the last 7 days of each feed (8 requests; the full feed runs from 2020 at roughly 600 occurrence updates a day): 0 of 33 live SessionSeries carry a name. 19 of 33 are priced 0 at CrossFit boxes and private gyms (Sierra Lima CrossFit 10, CrossFit Fierce Spirit, Roots Fitness, Fiitzone), which is membership-included. The adapter's is_free() would write 'Free to attend.' on them. Classes are booked in TeamUp. Out.
_not_included.https://data.bookwhen.com/: Bookwhen, a booking platform for independent instructors and groups. 2026-10-05, sampling the last 7 days (7 requests; the feed runs from 2021, and 33 of 50 page-one items are tombstones): 53 live series, all ticketed (GBP 4.95-100) and booked in advance. 9 are online-only (Zoom), and 0 of 77 offers carry advanceBooking. Some classes are in village halls and community centres, but each is an instructor's paid booking, not the centre's drop-in. Out, and a full walk would be tens of thousands of pages.
_not_included.https://api.findmyfacility.com/v1/openac: Find My Facility. EMPTY 2026-10-05: both feeds (sessionSeries, events) were read to the end in 3 requests and held only tombstones, 0 live records. An `empty`, not a `fail`, so it can be re-probed.
_not_included.https://dev.myeveryoneactive.com/OpenAct: Everyone Active's TEST tenant (EveryoneActive-test-* feeds), listed in the leisurecloud catalog beside the live one configured above. Never configure it: it would duplicate or contradict the live feed.
_not_included._legacy_untyped_feeds: 9 dataset sites give no feed type: Upshot (its own entry), England Netball and Let's Ride (above), and six more read 2026-10-05 with one request each. data.better.org.uk (www.better.org.uk/odi/sessions.json) is superseded by the better-admin feeds configured above, and its records carry no startDate. British Orienteering's fixture list is competitive events, not a centre timetable. British Triathlon answered 502. GO Mammoth's are adult league registrations. LTA ClubSpark (api.clubspark.uk/odi/public/courses): its robots.txt answers 403 with a Cloudflare page, so permission cannot be established there (a `fail`, not a `refused`), and the survey's fetcher wrongly stopped before the feed. The feed is a documented API and exempt. Probed once on 2026-10-05, it answered 200: page one held 99 SessionSeries and 1 tombstone, all modified 2026-07-28, every one a ClubSpark Course (LTA Youth Start Course 18, Barclays Big Tennis Weekends 8, LTA Youth Girls 9). 65 of 99 mention a term and 0 say drop-in. Registration courses, so out; not walked further. SportStarta's dev API does not resolve. Two more dataset sites do not parse: data.runtogether.co.uk says 'Nothing to see here', and api.premiertennis.co.uk/openactive is refused by robots.txt ('Disallow: /').
